caption: The drawing depicts a single rectangular wooden object, which appears to be a decorated box or tray with flared curved sides. The object is placed on a plain, light beige surface with no other items present in the composition. The outer surface of the box is a dark reddish-brown color, while the inner surface displays intricate yellow decorative patterns of leaves and abstract geometric shapes along the central upper edge, with additional leafy designs in yellow and green hues extending onto the end panels. The interior also has patches of green and orange, indicating more floral or foliage decorations. There is a subtle shadow underneath and to the right of the object, suggesting a light source from the upper left. The artist's signature and the year "1938" are visible on the lower right of the surface.
title: Bread or Apple Tray
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
